reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the little sachets, one a day that I can toss in my bag between school run and work, and the QR lab report on the box. $29.99 with free shipping is an easy impulse buy if the creator's video hits my sleep problem, and I'd try one box.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I might not finish it.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial box at a lower price, so I'm not stuck with 30 sachets if I feel nothing.
